geography: Hell Creek, Lance and age-equivalent latest Maastrichtian formations
overview: A latest Maastrichtian tyrannosaurid represented by a large specimen sample; the dossier separates specimen anatomy and traces from fitted growth, bite-force and abundance models.

ecology.diet: Carnivorous, with direct bite-trace and coprolite evidence for bone consumption
ecology.habitat: Continental floodplain systems in western North America
ecology.bodySize: Large-bodied; size and mass estimates vary among specimens and reconstructions
ecology.guild: Large terrestrial predator and carcass processor

traits: Deep, robust skull with enlarged teeth
Two-fingered forelimb and powerful hindlimb
Ontogenetic cranial changes documented across a multi-institution specimen series
evidenceSummary: Stratigraphic census, growth-series anatomy, bone traces and coprolite contents are observations; population density, maturity, body mass, bite force and tooth pressure remain model-dependent inferences.

title.en: Several kinds of evidence, several kinds of inference
title.zh: 多种证据，对应不同层次的推断

text.en:
Tyrannosaurus rex is known from a large specimen sample, but no single fossil contains the whole account. A Hell Creek stratigraphic census tracks occurrences; a growth series compares skull changes across specimens; bite traces and coprolite contents preserve evidence of feeding on bone. Each line answers a different question about presence, development or behaviour.

The observations do not automatically yield population density, adult mass or bite performance. Those quantities depend on sampling and models, while tooth marks and coprolites support a narrower conclusion: bone was consumed. Keeping the sample, trace and model separate makes the animal’s history easier to read without turning one estimate into a universal fact.
text.zh:
暴龙有大量标本记录，但没有一件化石能独自讲完全部故事。Hell Creek 地层普查记录化石出现；生长序列比较不同个体的头骨变化；咬痕和粪化石内容物则保存了啃食骨骼的证据。每条证据回答不同问题，分别涉及出现、发育或行为。

这些观察并不会自动给出种群密度、成体体重或咬合性能。相关数值取决于取样和模型；牙痕与粪化石能支持的结论更窄：暴龙曾摄食骨骼。把样本、痕迹和模型分开阅读，才能避免把某个估计当成普遍事实。

overview: The cited redescription treats the type and referred material of Ankylosaurus magniventris, documenting its long, low skull, large neck armour and broad tail club. This account stays with those named specimens and formations.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited anatomical redescription
ecology.habitat: Not resolved beyond the named formation occurrences
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited anatomical redescription
ecology.bodySize: Not resolved by the cited anatomical redescription

traits: A long, low skull with prominent laterally or dorsolaterally projecting cranial horns
A large cervical half-ring associated with the shoulder region
A large, low tail club documented in the redescribed material
evidenceSummary: The redescription supplies specimen-level anatomy, armor and formation records. It does not directly establish diet, behavior, locomotion or a species-wide habitat preference.

title.en: A low skull, neck armour and tail club
title.zh: 低矮头骨、颈部甲片与尾锤

text.en: The redescription documents a long, low skull with prominent horns, a large cervical half-ring over the shoulder region, and a broad, low tail club. These are anatomical observations from the type and referred material in the cited study.
text.zh: 重描述记录了长而低矮、带有明显角突的头骨，肩部上方的大型颈部半环，以及宽阔、低矮的尾锤。这些是引文研究所讨论正模和归入标本的形态观察。

title.en: Anatomy is not a behavior record
title.zh: 形态记录不等于行为记录

text.en: The named material and formations support the described anatomy and occurrences. The redescription does not test what Ankylosaurus ate or how it moved, and the formation setting alone cannot assign a preferred habitat.
text.zh: 具名标本和地层记录支持这里描述的形态与出现信息。重描述没有检验 Ankylosaurus 的食物或运动方式，仅凭地层环境也无法指定其偏好的栖地。

overviewZh: 所引重描述研究考察了 Ankylosaurus magniventris 的模式材料和归入材料，记录其头骨细长低平、颈部甲片大，以及尾锤宽阔。本条仅涉及这些明确列出的标本和地层。
evidenceSummaryZh: 重新描述提供了标本层面的解剖结构、甲胄和地层记录。它没有直接确定食性、行为、运动方式或该物种整体的栖息地偏好。

geography: Candelária Sequence, Santa Maria Formation, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
overview: Carnian sauropodomorph holotype ULBRA-PVT280 preserves an articulated skeleton. Its anatomy and teeth inform a faunivory hypothesis, while reconstruction of ancestral diet depends on the sampled evolutionary tree.

ecology.diet: Recurved, serrated teeth are compatible with faunivory in the study’s character-based reconstruction; gut contents are not preserved.
ecology.habitat: The record is bounded to the Candelária Sequence; a broader habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: A terrestrial, bipedal gait is an anatomical interpretation, not observed behavior.
ecology.bodySize: It is small-bodied within the early dinosauromorph comparison; no exact size is given here.
ecology.guild: The study reconstructs it as a faunivorous early sauropodomorph, a result dependent on its character sampling and tree.
ecology.dietZh: 弯曲且具锯齿的牙齿与研究中特征分析所支持的动物性食物假说相符；没有保存胃内容物。
ecology.habitatZh: 现有记录限于 Candelária 层序，不能据此概括更广的栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 陆生双足行走是根据解剖作出的解释，并非直接观察到的行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 在早期恐龙形类比较中属于小型；这里没有给出精确体型。
ecology.guildZh: 该研究依据特征分析将它重建为取食动物性食物的早期蜥脚形类，这一结论依赖取样和系统树。

traits: The articulated holotype includes a partial skull, axial skeleton, forelimb and nearly complete left hind limb.
The preserved teeth are recurved and serrated.
A sampled morphological matrix recovers Buriolestes among sauropodomorphs.
evidenceSummary: The holotype and formation context are direct evidence. Diet, locomotion and placement in the sampled tree are comparative inferences and do not establish direct ancestry.
overviewZh: 肉食龙正模 ULBRA-PVT280 保存了关节连接的骨架。其解剖和牙齿用于检验取食动物性食物的假说；祖先食性的重建则取决于所采用的演化树。
traitsZh: 关节连接的正模包括部分头骨、躯干骨骼、前肢和近乎完整的左后肢。
保存的牙齿呈弯曲状并有锯齿。
一项取样的形态矩阵将 Buriolestes 恢复为蜥脚形类。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模与地层背景属于直接证据；食性、运动方式及其在取样树中的位置是比较推断，不能证明直接祖先关系。

overview: Yinlong downsi is represented by the nearly complete holotype IVPP V14530 from the upper Shishugou Formation. The specimen preserves a broad skull behind the eyes and a shallow snout; the published matrix places it among basal ceratopsians, but does not establish direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: The anatomical and phylogenetic study does not directly establish diet.
ecology.habitat: The holotype locality is Wucaiwan in the Junggar Basin, Xinjiang; a broader habitat preference is not resolved.
ecology.locomotion: Short forelimbs and robust hindlimbs are compatible with bipedality, but gait is not observed in the fossil.
ecology.bodySize: The holotype is estimated at about 120 cm in total length; the estimate applies to this specimen.
ecology.guild: The cited anatomy and matrix study does not assign an ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 这项解剖和系统发育研究没有直接确定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 正模产地位于新疆准噶尔盆地的五彩湾；尚未确定更广泛的生境偏好。
ecology.locomotionZh: 前肢较短、后肢粗壮，与两足行走相符，但化石没有记录其实际步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 估计正模全长约 120 cm；该估计仅适用于这件标本。
ecology.guildZh: 所引解剖和矩阵研究没有指定生态类群。

traits: Holotype IVPP V14530 is a nearly complete skeleton missing the distal tail
The skull is proportionally broad in the post-orbital region and shallow in the pre-orbital region
The diagnosis records distinctive cranial features including a frontal midline fossa and a trapezoidal quadratojugal
evidenceSummary: IVPP V14530, its upper Shishugou Formation locality and the described anatomy are specimen-level evidence. The study's 161.2–155.7 Ma envelope applies to this occurrence, not a global first appearance. Bipedality is inferred from limb proportions, and basal placement remains a result of the sampled character matrix.

title.en: What the holotype preserves
title.zh: 正模保存的结构

text.en: The nearly complete skeleton IVPP V14530 is missing the distal tail. Its skull is broad behind the eye sockets and shallow in front; the diagnosis also records a frontal midline fossa and a trapezoidal quadratojugal. The individual is estimated at about 120 cm long. Short forelimbs and robust hindlimbs support a bipedal interpretation, not an observed gait.
text.zh: 近完整骨架 IVPP V14530 只缺少尾部末端。头骨在眼眶后较宽、吻部较浅；诊断还记录了额骨中线凹窝和梯形方轭骨。正模个体估计全长约 120 厘米。前肢较短、后肢粗壮与两足行走解释相容，但化石没有直接保存步态。

title.en: The sample and the character analysis
title.zh: 取样地点与性状分析

text.en: The holotype comes from Wucaiwan in the Junggar Basin, Xinjiang, in the upper Shishugou Formation. The 161.2–155.7 Ma interval is a literature-bounded envelope for this occurrence. A character-matrix analysis recovers Yinlong downsi as a basal ceratopsian; that placement depends on the study's character scoring and sampling and does not make the specimen a direct ancestor or a global first appearance.
text.zh: 正模来自新疆准噶尔盆地五彩湾的上石树沟组。161.2–155.7 Ma 是文献为这件出现记录设定的年代包络。性状矩阵分析将 Yinlong downsi 恢复为基干角龙类；位置取决于研究的性状评分和类群取样，并不说明该标本是直系祖先或全球最早记录。

geography: Three-skeleton sample: ZCDM V5000, ZCDM V5001 and ELDM V1001
overview: The study describes three nearly complete *Yutyrannus huali* skeletons from the Yixian Formation, representing two growth stages. The specimens preserve long filamentous integument, a three-fingered hand, and a typical theropod foot. Their basal tyrannosauroid placement is a result of the study’s sampled analysis, not a direct-ancestor claim.

ecology.diet: Not directly resolved by the cited description
ecology.habitat: Not resolved beyond the Yixian Formation provenance of the three specimens
ecology.locomotion: A three-fingered manus and typical theropod pes are described anatomy, not direct observations of locomotor behaviour
ecology.bodySize: Large body size is reported for the named skeleton sample; whole-population variation is not established
ecology.guild: No ecological guild is assigned from the cited specimen and matrix study

traits: The three nearly complete skeletons represent two ontogenetic stages
The described anatomy includes a three-fingered manus and a typical theropod pes
Long filamentous integumentary structures are preserved on the named specimen sample
evidenceSummary: The named skeletons preserve filamentous integument, but do not reveal its original colour, full-body coverage, or whether it provided insulation or display. The fossils do not directly record behaviour or locomotor performance. The phylogenetic placement depends on the taxa and characters included in the study’s analysis.

title.en: Three Yixian skeletons ground the study
title.zh: 义县组三具骨架构成研究材料

text.en: The study describes three nearly complete *Yutyrannus huali* skeletons from the Yixian Formation, representing two growth stages. The specimens preserve long filamentous integument, a three-fingered hand, and a typical theropod foot. Their basal tyrannosauroid placement is a result of the study’s sampled analysis, not a direct-ancestor claim.
text.zh: 研究描述了来自义县组的三具近乎完整 *Yutyrannus huali* 骨架，代表两个生长阶段。标本保存长丝状体被、三指手部和典型兽脚类足部。研究的取样分析将它置于暴龙超科较基干位置；这是系统发育分析结果，不表示直接祖先关系。

title.en: Skeletons, hands, feet, and preserved filaments
title.zh: 骨架保存的手足结构与丝状体被

text.en: Three nearly complete skeletons from the Yixian Formation represent two ontogenetic stages. The described anatomy includes a three-fingered hand and a typical theropod foot. Long filamentous integument is preserved on the named specimens. These observations apply to the cited sample.
text.zh: 三具近乎完整骨架代表两个个体发育阶段。所描述的解剖包括三指手部和典型兽脚类足部；具名标本还保存长丝状体被。这些观察限定于研究中的标本样本。

title.en: Ecological claims stop at the named sample
title.zh: 体型与生活方式的证据边界

text.en: The cited description reports large body size for the named skeleton sample but does not establish population-wide variation. Diet and broader habitat preference remain unresolved; hand and foot anatomy do not directly record locomotion. The specimen and matrix study assigns no ecological guild.
text.zh: 所引描述报告具名骨架样本体型较大，但不能据三具骨架推定整个种群的体型变异。食性和更广泛的栖地偏好尚未确定；手足结构不是运动行为的直接记录，标本与矩阵研究也未指定生态功能群。

title.en: Limits of anatomical and phylogenetic inference
title.zh: 解剖观察与系统发育推断的边界

text.en: The named skeletons preserve filamentous integument, but do not reveal its original colour, full-body coverage, or whether it provided insulation or display. The fossils do not directly record behaviour or locomotor performance. The phylogenetic placement depends on the taxa and characters included in the study’s analysis.

geography: Upper Cretaceous Western Interior material from Montana, Wyoming and Alberta
overview: Carpenter’s redescription documents Ankylosaurus magniventris from named Upper Cretaceous Western Interior material. The specimens show a long, low skull with prominent horns, a large cervical half-ring and a low tail club; this anatomical account does not establish diet, gait or behaviour.

ecology.diet: The cited redescription does not determine diet.
ecology.habitat: The study records formations and localities, not habitat preference.
ecology.locomotion: The cited redescription does not test locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: The cited redescription does not establish a body-size estimate for this profile.
ecology.guild: No ecological guild is assigned from the anatomical redescription.
ecology.dietZh: 所引重描述研究没有确定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 该研究记录了地层和产地，并未确定栖息地偏好。

ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引重描述研究没有为本条建立体型估计。

traits: The skull is long and low, with prominent cranial horns projecting laterally or dorsolaterally.
A large cervical half-ring is associated with the shoulder region.
The referred material documents a large, low tail club.
evidenceSummary: The redescription supplies specimen-level anatomy and formation records for accepted material. It does not extend every isolated ankylosaurid remain into the species or infer feeding and movement from armour.
overviewZh: Carpenter 的重描述记录了来自西部内陆区、上白垩统且具名的 Ankylosaurus magniventris 材料。标本显示其头骨低而长、具有显著头角，并有大型颈部半环和低位尾锤；这份解剖描述不能确定食性、步态或行为。
evidenceSummaryZh: 重描述为已接受材料提供了标本层级的解剖与地层记录。它没有把每件孤立的甲龙科遗骸都归入该物种，也没有根据甲片推断取食和运动。

readerSources.title: Redescription of Ankylosaurus magniventris Brown 1908 (Ankylosauridae) from the Upper Cretaceous of the Western Interior of North America

scope.en: Carpenter (2004), pp. 961–986, Figures 1–19 and Tables 1–3: holotype and referred material, revised diagnosis, specimen anatomy, and Hell Creek, Lance and Scollard formation records.
scope.zh: Carpenter（2004），第 961–986 页、图 1–19 与表 1–3：正模及归入材料、修订诊断、标本解剖，以及 Hell Creek、Lance 和 Scollard 组记录。

title.en: Low skull, neck armour and tail club in named material
title.zh: 低矮头骨、颈部半环与尾锤

text.en: Carpenter’s redescription documents Ankylosaurus magniventris from named Upper Cretaceous Western Interior material. The specimens show a long, low skull with prominent horns, a large cervical half-ring and a low tail club; this anatomical account does not establish diet, gait or behaviour.
text.zh: Carpenter 的重描述记录了来自西部内陆区、上白垩统且具名的 Ankylosaurus magniventris 材料。标本显示其头骨低而长、具有显著头角，并有大型颈部半环和低位尾锤；这份解剖描述不能确定食性、步态或行为。

title.en: Named material and its limits
title.zh: 具名材料及其解释边界

text.en: The redescription supplies specimen-level anatomy and formation records for accepted material. It does not extend every isolated ankylosaurid remain into the species or infer feeding and movement from armour.
text.zh: 重描述为已接受材料提供了标本层级的解剖与地层记录。它没有把每件孤立的甲龙科遗骸都归入该物种，也没有根据甲片推断取食和运动。

traitsZh: 头骨长而低，具有向侧方或背外侧突出的显著头角。
肩部区域有一大片颈部半环甲片。
归入该种的材料记录了一根大型、低矮的尾锤。

geography: Candelária Sequence, Santa Maria Formation, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
overview: The articulated holotype ULBRA-PVT280 preserves much of the skeleton, including a partial skull and nearly complete left hind limb. Its recurved, serrated teeth support a study-based hypothesis of animal-eating, while diet and the species' place among sauropodomorphs remain interpretations from comparative analyses.

ecology.diet: Recurved, serrated teeth are compatible with faunivory in the study's character-based reconstruction; the fossil does not preserve a meal.
ecology.habitat: The cited occurrence is from the Candelária Sequence; this record does not establish a preferred living habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial bipedal movement is an interpretation of the anatomy, not a preserved behaviour.
ecology.bodySize: The study describes it as small-bodied relative to the early dinosauromorphs in its comparison.
ecology.guild: The study's character-based reconstruction treats it as a faunivorous early sauropodomorph; this is not a directly observed feeding guild.
ecology.dietZh: 在该研究基于性状的重建中，后弯且带锯齿的牙齿与以动物为食的解释相符；化石未保存它吃下的食物。
ecology.habitatZh: 所引记录来自 Candelária 层序；该记录不能确定其偏好的生活生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 对其陆生两足运动的判断来自解剖特征解释，并非行为保存记录。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 与研究比较的早期恐龙形类相比，该研究将其描述为体型较小。
ecology.guildZh: 研究基于特征的重建将其视为食动物的早期蜥脚形类；这并非直接观察到的摄食生态类群。

traits: An articulated holotype includes a partial skull, axial skeleton, forelimb and nearly complete left hind limb
The preserved teeth are recurved and serrated
The study recovered the taxon among sauropodomorphs in its sampled morphology matrix
evidenceSummary: ULBRA-PVT280 and its Candelária Sequence locality are documented material. The diet reconstruction and sauropodomorph placement come from comparative analyses, not direct observation or evidence of ancestry.

title.en: An articulated skeleton and recurved teeth
title.zh: 关节相连的骨骼与后弯牙齿

text.en: The holotype ULBRA-PVT280 includes a partial skull, axial skeleton, forelimb and nearly complete left hind limb. Its preserved teeth curve backward and carry serrations. These are observations from the named specimen; the character-based study used the teeth to test a possible animal-eating diet, but the fossil does not record what this individual ate.
text.zh: 正模 ULBRA-PVT280 包括部分头骨、中轴骨骼、前肢和近乎完整的左后肢。保存下来的牙齿向后弯曲并带有锯齿。这些是具名标本中的观察；研究者在基于性状的分析中用牙齿检验动物性食物的可能性，但化石没有记录这只个体实际吃了什么。

title.en: A sampled branch, not a direct ancestor
title.zh: 树上的位置不等于直接祖先

text.en: The study's morphology matrix recovered Buriolestes among sauropodomorphs, but a position in a sampled tree does not establish direct ancestry. The holotype comes from the Candelária Sequence of the Santa Maria Formation in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. This named occurrence does not by itself provide a complete species range or settle habitat and locomotion.
text.zh: 研究的形态矩阵将 Buriolestes 恢复在蜥脚形类之中，但取样树上的位置不能证明直接祖先关系。正模出自巴西南里奥格兰德州 Santa Maria 组的 Candelária 层序。这个具名化石记录不能单独提供完整物种分布，也不能确定其栖息地或运动方式。

title.en: Cabreira et al. (2016), Buriolestes anatomy and diet analysis
title.zh: Cabreira 等（2016），Buriolestes 解剖与食性分析

scope.en: Holotype ULBRA-PVT280, the Candelária Sequence locality, dental description and sampled morphology analysis; pages 3090–3095, Figures 1–3 and Figure S3. The source supports specimen anatomy and the study's comparative diet and phylogenetic results, not a direct-ancestor claim or a complete global range.
scope.zh: 正模 ULBRA-PVT280、Candelária 层序地点、牙齿描述和取样形态分析；第 3090–3095 页、图 1–3 与图 S3。该来源支持标本解剖及研究中的比较食性和系统发育结果，不支持直接祖先断言或完整全球分布。

overviewZh: 关节相连的正模 ULBRA-PVT280 保存了大部分骨架，包括部分头骨和近乎完整的左后肢。弯曲且具锯齿的牙齿支持研究提出的食动物假说；食性及其在蜥脚形类中的位置仍是基于比较分析的解释。
evidenceSummaryZh: ULBRA-PVT280 及其 Candelária 层序产地均有记录。食性重建和蜥脚形类归属来自比较分析，而非直接观察或祖先关系证据。

overview: Yinlong downsi is based on the nearly complete holotype IVPP V14530, which preserves a distinctive skull and limb proportions. The anatomy is directly described; its position among early ceratopsians comes from a character-matrix analysis.

ecology.diet: Not directly resolved by the cited anatomical and phylogenetic study
ecology.habitat: Not resolved beyond the Wucaiwan upper Shishugou Formation locality
ecology.locomotion: Relatively short forelimbs and robust hindlimbs support a bipedal anatomical interpretation, not observed behaviour
ecology.bodySize: The holotype is estimated at about 120 cm total length; that estimate is specimen-specific
ecology.guild: No ecological guild is assigned from this anatomy and matrix study

traits: Holotype IVPP V14530 is a nearly complete skeleton missing the distal tail
The skull is proportionally broad in the post-orbital region and shallow in the pre-orbital region
The diagnosis records distinctive cranial features including a frontal midline fossa and a trapezoidal quadratojugal
evidenceSummary: The holotype comes from Wucaiwan in the upper Shishugou Formation. A bipedal interpretation and a basal ceratopsian placement are study results, not observed behavior or evidence that Yinlong was a direct ancestor.

title.en: The holotype preserves a distinctive skull
title.zh: 正模保存了可鉴别的头骨

text.en: IVPP V14530 is nearly complete, although the end of its tail is missing. The description records a broad skull behind the eye, a shallower region in front of the eye, a frontal midline hollow and a trapezoidal quadratojugal. The reported total length of about 120 cm is an estimate for this individual, not a measured species-wide size range.
text.zh: IVPP V14530 近乎完整，但尾端缺失。描述记录了眼眶后部较宽、眼前区较浅的头骨形态，以及额骨中线凹窝和梯形颧方骨。约 120 厘米的全长是对这一只个体的估计，并非对整个物种测得的体型范围。

title.en: Separate anatomy from the family tree
title.zh: 把解剖观察与系统树分开

text.en: Short forelimbs and robust hindlimbs are compatible with a bipedal interpretation, but the fossil does not preserve an observed walk. The cited character matrix places Yinlong among basal ceratopsians; that is a result of the sampled characters and taxa, not a direct-ancestor claim. The study does not resolve diet or a preferred habitat from this skeleton.
text.zh: 较短的前肢和粗壮的后肢与两足行走解释相容，但化石没有保存实际行走行为。所引特征矩阵把 Yinlong 置于基干角龙类之中；这是由纳入性状和类群得出的结果，不表示它是直接祖先。该研究也未能由这具骨架确定食性或偏好栖地。

overviewZh: Yinlong downsi 以近乎完整的正模 IVPP V14530 为依据，保存了独特的头骨和肢体比例。其解剖特征由直接描述获得；它在早期角龙类中的位置则来自特征矩阵分析。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模来自五彩湾的石树沟组上部。其双足行走解释和基干角龙类位置是研究结果，并非观察到的行为，也不表明 Yinlong 是直接祖先。

geography: Three-skeleton sample: ZCDM V5000, ZCDM V5001 and ELDM V1001
overview: Three nearly complete *Yutyrannus huali* skeletons from the Yixian Formation represent two growth stages. They preserve long filamentous integument, a three-fingered hand, and a typical theropod foot. A sampled analysis places the species near the base of Tyrannosauroidea; this is an analysis result, not a direct-ancestor claim.
overviewZh: 义县组的三具近乎完整 *Yutyrannus huali* 骨架代表两个生长阶段，保存长丝状体被、三指手部和典型兽脚类足部。取样分析将该种置于暴龙超科较基干的位置；这是系统发育分析结果，不表示它是其他类群的直接祖先。

ecology.diet: Diet is not resolved by the cited description.
ecology.habitat: The three specimens come from the Yixian Formation; a broader habitat preference is not established.
ecology.locomotion: The hand and foot are described anatomy, not direct observations of locomotor behaviour.
ecology.bodySize: Large body size is reported for this named sample; population-wide variation is unknown.
ecology.guild: The cited specimen and matrix study does not assign an ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 所引描述没有确定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 三件标本均来自义县组；尚未确定更广泛的栖息地偏好。
ecology.locomotionZh: 手部和足部属于所描述的解剖结构，并非对运动行为的直接观察。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所列样本被报道为大型个体；整个种群的体型变异未知。
ecology.guildZh: 所引标本研究和特征矩阵分析没有为其指定生态功能类群。

traits: Three nearly complete skeletons represent two ontogenetic stages
A three-fingered manus and typical theropod pes are described
Long filamentous integument is preserved in the named sample
evidenceSummary: The three Yixian skeletons preserve long filaments. Their tyrannosauroid placement comes from a sampled phylogenetic analysis; the fossils do not establish the filaments’ colour or function.

readerLimitations.en: The anatomical and phylogenetic account concerns Xu et al.’s (2012) three-skeleton sample. The PBDB collection record has its own identification and age interval.
readerLimitations.zh: 身体结构与亲缘关系的解释限定于 Xu 等（2012）的三具骨架样本；PBDB 采集记录另有自己的鉴定与年代区间。

evidenceSummaryZh: 义县组的三具骨架保存长丝状体被。其暴龙超科位置来自取样系统发育分析；化石尚未确定丝状体被的颜色或功能。
traitsZh: 三具近乎完整的骨架代表两个个体发育阶段。
描述了三指的手部和典型兽脚类足部。
具名样本中保存了长丝状体表覆盖物。

overview: Dinosauria’s 233.2–0 Ma display links fossils to living birds as a navigation composite, not a global first appearance or continuous fossil record.

ecology.diet: Diet varied across lineages; no single group-wide diet is inferred here.
ecology.habitat: The page links terrestrial fossil samples with the living-bird continuation; it does not define one habitat for Dinosauria.
ecology.locomotion: Locomotor anatomy and behaviour differ across included lineages; the examples below are not a group-wide performance model.
ecology.bodySize: Body size varied widely across the lineage; no single size estimate is derived from the selected fossils.
ecology.guild: Diverse terrestrial and aerial lineages; no single ecological guild is assigned to the whole group.

traits: The route includes the sampled Late Triassic holotype ULBRA-PVT280 and living birds.
Early dinosaur relationships remain sensitive to matrix coding and taxon sampling.
evidenceSummary: ULBRA-PVT280 anchors a Late Triassic sample; competing matrices and the Yutyrannus example remain study-bounded, not global or universal claims.

title.en: A route assembled from different samples
title.zh: 这条路线串起不同化石样本

text.zh: 这条图谱路线把不同化石样本连接到现生鸟类。一件晚三叠世骨架保存了部分头骨和肢体；三件早白垩世羽王龙骨架保存了丝状体表结构。这些记录回答不同的解剖问题，而页面所示 2.332 亿年至今只是导航跨度，并非连续的化石出现记录。
text.en: This atlas route links distinct fossil samples to living birds. A Late Triassic skeleton preserves parts of a skull and limbs; three Early Cretaceous Yutyrannus skeletons preserve filamentous integument. Those records answer different anatomical questions, while the route’s displayed 233.2–0 Ma span is a navigation composite rather than a continuous occurrence record.

title.en: The Brazilian skeleton at about 233.2 Ma
title.zh: 约 2.332 亿年前的巴西骨架

text.en: Holotype ULBRA-PVT280 comes from an approximately 233.2 Ma assemblage in the Candelária Sequence of southern Brazil. It preserves a partial skull, axial skeleton, forelimb and nearly complete left hind limb. This local sample establishes what was present at that site and time; it does not fix a global first appearance or make Buriolestes a direct ancestor of later dinosaurs.
text.zh: 正模 ULBRA-PVT280 出自巴西南部 Candelária Sequence 中约 2.332 亿年前的生物组合。它保存部分头骨、轴骨骼、前肢和近乎完整的左后肢。这个局地样本说明该地点当时存在什么，却不能确定全球恐龙首现，也不能证明 Buriolestes 是后期恐龙的直系祖先。

title.en: Two analyses recover competing early trees
title.zh: 两项分析恢复了相互竞争的早期系统树

text.en: One analysis of 74 taxa and 457 characters grouped Theropoda with Ornithischia as Ornithoscelida. A published reanalysis changed character scores and added taxa, recovering the traditional ornithischian–saurischian split. These are outcomes of different matrices: coding and sampling change the inferred early branches, and neither analysis directly observes ancestry.
text.zh: 一项包含 74 个分类单元和 457 项性状的分析，将兽脚类与鸟臀类合为 Ornithoscelida。随后发表的重分析改变性状编码并增加分类单元，恢复了传统的鸟臀类—蜥臀类分支。这些是不同矩阵得出的竞争结果：编码和取样会改变早期分支推断，任何一项分析都没有直接观察到祖先关系。

title.en: Filaments in three Yutyrannus skeletons
title.zh: 三件羽王龙骨架上的丝状结构

text.en: Three nearly complete Yutyrannus skeletons from the Lower Cretaceous Yixian Formation preserve long filamentous integument. They document those structures in this tyrannosauroid sample only; they do not establish full-body coverage, the filaments’ function, or the integument of every dinosaur lineage.
text.zh: 来自早白垩世义县组的三件近乎完整羽王龙骨架保存了细长丝状体表结构。它们只记录这一组暴龙超科样本中的结构；不能据此确定全身覆盖、丝状物的功能，或所有恐龙谱系的体表状况。

title.en: Cabreira et al. (2016), the Buriolestes assemblage
title.zh: Cabreira 等（2016），Buriolestes 生物组合

scope.en: Primary description of the ULBRA-PVT280 holotype and Candelária Sequence assemblage; the local age context does not establish a global dinosaur first appearance.
scope.zh: 对 ULBRA-PVT280 正模和 Candelária Sequence 生物组合的一手描述；局地年代背景不能确立全球恐龙首现。

title.en: Baron et al. (2017), a dinosaur relationships matrix
title.zh: Baron 等（2017），恐龙亲缘关系矩阵

scope.en: The 74-taxon, 457-character analysis recovered Ornithoscelida; this is a matrix topology rather than observed ancestry.
scope.zh: 这项包含 74 个分类单元、457 项性状的分析恢复 Ornithoscelida；这是矩阵拓扑结果，而非观察到的祖先关系。

title.en: Langer et al. (2017), dinosaur tree reanalysis
title.zh: Langer 等（2017），恐龙系统树重分析

scope.en: Rescoring and adding taxa recovered the traditional ornithischian–saurischian split, illustrating sensitivity to matrix composition and coding.
scope.zh: 重新编码并增加分类单元后，研究恢复传统的鸟臀类—蜥臀类分支，显示结果受矩阵组成与编码影响。

title.en: Xu et al. (2012), Yutyrannus skeletons and integument
title.zh: Xu 等（2012），羽王龙骨架与体表结构

scope.en: Three nearly complete Yixian Formation skeletons preserve filamentous integument; function and full-body coverage are not direct observations.
scope.zh: 三件义县组近乎完整骨架保存了丝状体表结构；其功能与全身覆盖并非直接观察所得。

readerLimitations.en: This atlas concept is marked unresolved and has no fixed PBDB taxon ID. The page follows a selected fossil sample into the atlas's living-bird navigation; 233.2–0 Ma is not an uninterrupted occurrence interval. The cited specimens and topology analyses do not form a complete dinosaur ecology or evolutionary history.
readerLimitations.zh: 本图谱概念标记为未解决，且没有固定 PBDB 分类单元 ID。页面从精选化石样本延伸至图谱中的现生鸟类导航；2.332 亿年前至今不是连续的出现记录。所引标本与拓扑分析不能构成完整恐龙生态或演化史综述。
